name: Calendar event booked
oneLiner: a glass calendar day view turns in 3D, an event block is held above it then drops into its hour slot and snaps on a spring, the invitees pop in on it and a Booked check stamps onto its corner
say: when the speaker talks about booking calls or meetings ('my calendar filled up', 'they book a call'): the block drops on the booking word, the check stamps on 'booked'
